Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the B1-3 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.5-F in the area
bound by:

North Clark Street; a line 234.78 feet north of West Belden Avenue as measured
along the east right-of-way line of North Clark Street and perpendicular thereto; a
line 83 feet east of North Clark Street as measured along the north right-of-way line
of West Belden Avenue; and a line 151.78 feet north of West Belden Avenue as
measured along the east right-of-way line of North Clark Street and perpendicular
thereto.

to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage
and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2317 North Clark Street, Chicago Illinois.
